node.label: David Armitage
node.date_label: The Ideological Origins of the British Empire (2000) · The Declaration of Independence: A Global History (2007) · Foundations of Modern International Thought (2013)
node.description: Intellectual and international historian who studies political concepts through their changing imperial and global settings. Armitage’s introduction to The Ideological Origins of the British Empire reconnects state formation in Britain and Ireland with empire and challenges a rigid domestic/overseas separation. His Atlantic research traces how a British imperial community was articulated, rather than assuming that it existed unchanged.
